versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) with Sub- Function startRoutine, the Dcm module shall check if the Routine can be executed in the current mode condition (see configuration parameter DcmDspStartRoutineCom- monAuthorizationRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send the calculated negative response code of the referenced DcmModeRule .
